Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The primary biological comparison is between healthy controls and IBD patients (including CD and UC subtypes). AEBSF is used as a chemical inhibitor to validate the activity of the proteases (active vs inhibited), but the core biological variable is the disease state. Samples for MS were pooled from 3 representative patients per group.
